description: Revises an idea, criticism or comment on Veritula by its number, as the person who connected the app and marked as written with AI. Revising posts a new version, with a number of its own, which replies to what the old version replied to. The old version's replies carry over to the new one, but those listed as answered: the criticisms it answers, which credits their authors, and comments that no longer apply. Anyone can revise anyone's idea, but only its author revises an article. The content is the new version in full, in Markdown; an article's opens with its title as a heading, as get_idea gives it. Revising takes signing in, and new accounts can post a few ideas a day.

answered.description: The numbers of the replies to the version revised that don’t carry over: the criticisms the new version answers, and comments that no longer apply

content.description: The new version in full, in Markdown

explanation.description: What changed, in brief, as the versions’ navigation shows it

id.description: The number of the version to revise, usually the latest
